<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a dominant monoisotopic peak at 134.11 with decreasing peaks at +1, +2, +3, etc. The relative intensities (~11% for M+1, ~0.5% for M+2) match the expected binomial distribution for a molecule containing roughly ten carbon atoms (each 13C ≈1.1%). No other element’s characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) fits these intensities. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
